title: medsum-fact processed (Review 2 baseline)
description: Unified dialogue->note jsonl for the FaCTS BCSE306L project: baseline_train/val mix (ACI-Bench + MTS-Dialog + sampled DialogueSOAP, seed 42) and the six official test splits. Built by scripts/import_datasets.py and scripts/make_baseline_split.py. Source corpora keep their own licences (ACI-Bench research use, MTS-Dialog CC BY 4.0, omi-health dialogue-to-SOAP per dataset card).
